name: ZMS_MOBILE_USAGES
description: This table stores the Mobile application usage data. The data would be used to build usage reports.

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table that would be unique for each event log record

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application Id representing the id of the mobile application

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_DATE
columns.description: This column stores the date the event was logged on the mobile device.

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_RECORD
columns.description: This column stores the log record of the event that was logged on the mobile device.

columns.name: EVENT_LOG_COUNTRY
columns.description: The country the event was logged from

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
